title.zh: 回覆健身中心的入會信

subtitle: 原創模擬題（多益寫作風格）：回覆電子郵件，提出兩個請求和一個問題
task:
Directions: Read the e-mail below. Respond to the e-mail as if you are a new member of the fitness center. In your e-mail, make TWO requests and ask ONE question.

From: Peak Fitness Center, Membership Office
To: Jason Huang
Subject: Welcome to Peak Fitness Center

Dear Mr. Huang,

Thank you for joining Peak Fitness Center. Your membership begins on May 1. If you have any requests or questions before your first visit, please reply to this e-mail.

Sincerely,
Membership Office
taskZh: 你剛加入 Peak Fitness Center 健身中心，會籍從 5 月 1 日開始。會員服務處來信歡迎你，並說第一次到場前有任何請求或問題都可以回信。請以新會員 Jason Huang 的身分回信，提出兩個請求和一個問題。
focus: 任務完成：兩個請求、一個問題都要明確，並說明理由
組織：用 First、Second 列出請求，問題另起一段
語氣：有禮貌，請求用 could you、I would like to 等委婉說法
文法與用字：問句語序、時態與日期的寫法正確

en: Thank you for your welcome e-mail. I am looking forward to starting my membership on May 1, and I have two requests. First, could you send me the class schedule for May? I would like to plan which yoga classes to join. Second, I would like to book a free session with a personal trainer during my first week, if possible.
I also have one question. Since I usually work out after work, how late is the center open on weekdays? Thank you, and I hope to hear from you soon.
zh: 謝謝您寄來的歡迎信。我很期待 5 月 1 日開始使用會籍，另外有兩個請求。第一，能否請您寄給我 5 月的課程表？我想先規劃要參加哪些瑜伽課。第二，如果可以的話，我想在第一週預約一次免費的私人教練課程。
另外，我有一個問題。因為我通常下班後才去運動，請問平日健身中心開到幾點？謝謝您，期待很快收到您的回覆。

patterns.zh: 表達期待（to 後面接動名詞）
patterns.example: I am looking forward to starting my membership on May 1, and I have two requests.

patterns.zh: 禮貌地請對方提供資料
patterns.example: First, could you send me the class schedule for May?

patterns.pattern: I would like to book …, if possible.
patterns.zh: 委婉地提出預約的請求
patterns.example: Second, I would like to book a free session with a personal trainer during my first week, if possible.

patterns.zh: 先說明原因，再提出問題
